title: humanize: add an ndigits option to intcomma
notes: A new rounding option for intcomma. The story is only the commit message.

defects.summary: ndigits=0 is ignored because the code tests 'if ndigits:', so intcomma(1234.5, ndigits=0) returns '1,234.5' instead of rounding to a whole number.
defects.trigger: intcomma with ndigits=0, e.g. intcomma(1234.5, ndigits=0)
defects.caught_if: a condition passes ndigits=0 (the falsy edge of the new option) and checks the result is rounded to no decimal places
defects.observed: at f14d5c1 intcomma(1234.5, ndigits=0) returned '1,234.5', the same as ndigits=1
